rubric.why: Electropositivity describes an atom’s tendency to give up electrons.
rubric.description: Identifies the tendency to lose or donate electrons.
rubric.how: Award for stating that an atom tends to lose or donate electrons.

rubric.why: Losing electrons produces positively charged ions.
rubric.description: States that electron loss forms positive ions.
rubric.how: Award for stating that this forms positive ions or cations.

modelAnswer: Electropositivity is the tendency of an atom to lose or donate electrons.
By losing electrons, the atom forms positive ions (cations).
